definition: Kuṭaja tree (Wrightia antidysenterica) — whose small, unimpressive flowers are mocked by showy blossoms. The poet sides with the humble tree over ostentation.

sources.claim: kuṭaja kiṃ kusumair avahasyate praṇipatāmi ca duṣprahasya te

translations.note: No English equivalent; the tree's small flowers are the point.
